name: agent-workflows
description: cw for Codex: tells the session that commits and pushes are gated on recorded passing checks, stops a command that would skip the gate, ships the skill `cw` on how to work with the gate and the skill `task` for a task workflow, and records the tokens a task used.

interface.shortDescription: A gate on commits and pushes, backed by the cw command
interface.longDescription: Tells the session that the repository gates commits and pushes on recorded passing runs of the checks declared in cw.toml, and stops a command that would skip the gate. The skill `task` takes a task from a specification to tested code through seven roles, and cw tokens reports what the task used. The roles were never run on Codex.
defaultPrompt: Run cw status and tell me which checks are missing
Run cw run and fix what fails
